description: Aquitaine : Fiche technique Défense des Forêts Contre l'Incendie (DFCI) - Empierrement de piste is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dfci-aquitaine.fr. List of standards, work and profiles required for Forest Fire Defense (DFCI) track encroachment. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Aquitaine: Data sheet Defence of Forests Against Fire (DFCI) - Runway widening" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspire, empierrement, risques, DFCI, techniques, pistes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
